58.9% and $0.61 are from Samaya FrontierFinance; the benchmark is vendor-maintained and cross-system cost accounting is not fully symmetric.
First commercial deployment was reported at a Guangdong 7-ELEVEN store; no public store-level ROI or rollout scale was found.
Secondhand report relayed by OSChina from The Information; no official confirmation from DeepSeek or investors located. Figures remain unconfirmed.
All generated visual assets are clearly labeled as thematic illustrations, not news-site photographs or documentary evidence.
